definitions.explanation: The dark material used to surface roads, or a road surface made of this material.

examples.japanese: アスファルト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧アスファルト⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熱|あつ}く→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧アスファルト⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{滑|すべ}りやすい→滑りやすい：27611_suberiyasui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{気|き}をつけて⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please be careful because asphalt is slippery on rainy days.

notes:
アスファルト refers to both the material itself and paved surfaces in general. In everyday Japanese, it often simply means a paved road as opposed to a dirt or gravel path.

ETYMOLOGY:
From English/Dutch "asphalt." The Japanese pronunciation drops the final consonant cluster.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アスファルト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to lay asphalt
- アスファルト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧: on the asphalt
- アスファルト⟦{舗装|ほそう}→舗装：08397_hosou⟧: asphalt paving
- アスファルト⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧: an asphalt road

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦コンクリート→コンクリート：10858_konkuriito⟧: concrete (another common road/building material)
- ⟦{舗装|ほそう}→舗装：08397_hosou⟧: paving, pavement
- ⟦{砂利|じゃり}{道|みち}→砂利道：16083_jarimichi⟧: gravel road (contrasts with paved roads)
